purpose: Read-only residual audit of every pending PPT/PPTX feature row against the finalized native Microsoft PowerPoint corpus. This file records bounded evidence or the reason a row remains operation-only, UI-limited, externally handed off, genuinely missing as an authorable family, or explicitly excluded.

scope.native_ui_session_state: No additional UI operation was attempted. Root reported that PowerPoint binding remains unavailable after the Preferences Save-pane and Finder Open With recovery attempts; existing inspection records are treated as authoritative.

classification_definitions.native_bounded_evidence: A finalized native fixture contains the named marker, record, package part, native reopen observation, or bounded reader result; the row remains limited to the stated fields.
classification_definitions.operation_only: The row describes a library transaction or runtime behavior for which this corpus has no row-specific native authoring/reopen evidence.
classification_definitions.observed_ui_limitation: Native PowerPoint or the accepted format conversion produced the named warning/fallback/visibility boundary; absence beyond that boundary is not inferred.
classification_definitions.external_handoff: Completion depends on a certificate, mail/browser/network, add-in/service, or other host outside the local package workflow.
classification_definitions.genuinely_missing_authorable_family: The current bounded writer has no authoring path for the requested semantic family; this is a library/authoring boundary, not a claim that the host cannot display it.
classification_definitions.excluded_baseline: Explicitly excluded by the parent task for this audit; no coverage claim is made.
